text: One of them came straight toward me. <break time="0.8s" /> A slight creature. <break time="0.8s" /> About four feet tall. <break time="0.8s" /> Dressed in a purple tunic. <break time="0.8s" /> With a leather belt. <break time="0.8s" /> He was beautiful and graceful. <break time="0.8s" /> But he was so frail. <break time="0.8s" /> That he looked like a little figure. <break time="0.8s" /> Made of fine china. <break time="0.8s" /> Showing no sign of fear. <break time="0.8s" /> He came up and laughed into my eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> And then several others began. <break time="0.8s" /> To touch me with soft little hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Their voices were soft and sweet. <break time="0.8s" /> And there was something so childlike. <break time="0.8s" /> About them. <break time="0.8s" /> That my fear soon melted away. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, remembering the danger. <break time="0.8s" /> I quickly unscrewed the small levers. <break time="0.8s" /> That started the machine. <break time="0.8s" /> And put them safely in my pocket. <break time="0.8s" /> One of them pointed to the sun. <break time="0.8s" /> And asked me by signs. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether I had come from it. <break time="0.8s" /> In the thunderstorm. <break time="0.8s" /> The question surprised me. <break time="0.8s" /> For it was the kind of question. <break time="0.8s" /> That a five year old child of our time might ask. <break time="0.8s" /> Then they brought chains of beautiful flowers. <break time="0.8s" /> Which they hung around my neck. <break time="0.8s" /> Laughing until I was almost covered with them.
